! What is irregular on dev-cisco-xe-reference-16 (4 items; the paste fixes 3, leaves 1):
!  1. aaa      ACCESS     missing: the console's own login list CONSOLE (local only, so a local user
!                         always gets in there) (aaa authentication login CONSOLE local). Fixed by
!                         region line 3.
!  2. aaa      ACCESS     missing: the accounting session id is common (aaa session-id common). Fixed
!                         by region line 4.
!  3. aaa      ACCESS     different: the login method of line con 0: login authentication CONSOLE (the
!                         device has: the login method of line con 0: login authentication default)
!                         (line con 0 > login authentication CONSOLE). Fixed by region line 7.
!  4. aaa      ACCESS     extra: aaa server radius dynamic-author client 192.0.2.7 server-key (aaa
!                         server radius dynamic-author > client 192.0.2.7 server-key <secret>). Left
!                         alone. To remove it later, type these lines in order: aaa server radius
!                         dynamic-author / no client 192.0.2.7
! Consistent: roles, snmp, mgmt-acl. Not planned: netconf, breakglass.
! Secrets: 2 present on the device, not changed (--secrets pushes them).
! WARNING: the device has no enable secret: with the server unreachable, level 15 is reached only
! through the local user and 'aaa authorization exec'; set an enable secret first if you want a second
! way.
! The change is live when the paste ends. NOTHING rolls it back by itself. Keep a second terminal
! logged in at privilege 15 until the end.
! Paste over ssh, not the console; on a console paste at most twenty lines at a time and watch the
! echo for '% Invalid'. Pasting the region twice is harmless.
!
! Type this first, on dev-cisco-xe-reference-16, and check the name:   show version | include uptime
! The prompt must end in # (privileged mode), not in (config)#, before you paste: a prompt ending in >
! means type enable first, a prompt with (config) in it means a configuration session is open: type
! end first.
!
!!!!! PASTE FROM HERE: dev-cisco-xe-reference-16 !!!!!
configure terminal
! aaa: the method lists tacctl renders, each replaced by the rendered line (the console's own list is local only)
aaa authentication login CONSOLE local
aaa session-id common
! aaa: the login method of the console and vty lines
line con 0
 login authentication CONSOLE
end
!!!!! PASTE TO HERE: dev-cisco-xe-reference-16 !!!!!

! If any line printed "% Invalid" or "% Error", stop and undo it: tacctl device config plan
! dev-cisco-xe-reference-16 --backout (its own region, to paste in the second terminal).
